overview: 本期共收录 6 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（5 篇）、收入分配与福利（1 篇）。方法上以实验方法、均衡模型为主。来源分布：arXiv（5 篇）、OpenAlex（1 篇）。

papers.title: Political stance detection on X during the 2024 U.S. election: a comparative study of classical, neural, and transformer models
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  As online social networks (OSNs) play an increasingly influential role in political communication, accurately detecting political stance from noisy, short-form content remains a significant challenge in computational social science (CSS). This paper presents a controlled comparison of text classification models for political stance detection during the 2024 U.S. presidential election, focusing on candidate affiliation toward Donald Trump and Joe Biden–Kamala Harris. Using nearly 100,000 posts from X, we define candidate affiliation as a three-class target variable (Trump, Biden–Kamala, or Neutral) and use topic modeling to support keyword development and thematic characterization. Under a unified preprocessing, labeling, and evaluation pipeline, we compare classical machine learning models, sentence-embedding-based neural architectures, and a domain-adapted transformer. Results suggest that task-aligned text representation accounts for most of the predictive signal in this setting. While fine-tuned BERTweet achieves the strongest in-domain performance, carefully engineered classical models, particularly linear support vector machines, remain highly competitive. Multi-feature and ablation analyses further indicate that expanded metadata did not yield reliable gains beyond strong text representations. Overall, this work provides a controlled comparison of text models for candidate affiliation on a heuristically labeled corpus.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
随着在线社交网络（OSNs）在政治传播中发挥越来越重要的作用，从噪声较大、形式简短的文本内容中准确检测政治立场仍然是计算社会科学（CSS）领域面临的一项重大挑战。本文对2024年美国总统选举期间用于政治立场检测的文本分类模型进行了对照研究，重点关注候选人对唐纳德·特朗普和乔·拜登-卡玛拉·哈里斯的支持倾向。我们使用了来自X平台的近10万条帖子，将候选人的支持倾向定义为三类目标变量（特朗普支持、拜登-卡玛拉支持或中立立场），并利用主题建模来辅助关键词提取和主题特征分析。在统一的预处理、标注和评估流程下，我们比较了传统的机器学习模型、基于句子嵌入的神经网络架构以及针对该领域进行了优化的Transformer模型。研究结果表明，在这种场景下，与任务相关的文本表示方式占据了预测效果的主要部分。尽管经过微调的BERTweet在特定任务上表现最佳，但精心设计的传统模型（尤其是线性支持向量机）依然具有很强的竞争力。多特征分析和消融实验进一步表明，扩展元数据并未在强大的文本表示基础上带来显著的提升效果。总体而言，本研究为在基于启发式标注的语料库上评估候选人的支持倾向提供了可靠的文本模型...。研究方法：机器学习、Transformer 模型、主题模型。

papers.title: Verifiable Settlement and Pricing for Local Energy Markets: Architecture and Deployment on Hyperledger Besu
papers.abstract: We implement privacy-preserving local electricity exchanges using an automated market maker on the Hyperledger Besu network under QBFT consensus. The proposed protocol operator collects individual electricity positions off-chain and publishes aggregate supply and demand on the blockchain, where smart contracts compute market prices every fifteen minutes. Individual positions remain off-chain; Poseidon2 commitments and UltraHonk zeroknowledge proofs, generated from Noir circuits, verify aggregation, payments, and daily balance updates. The architecture retains community coordination while making financial execution independently auditable. Signed receipts and member-triggered recourse prevent unverified or partial settlement. In a ten-household experiment using simulated US residential profiles, daily settlement uses approximately 19 million gas and produces eight-member proofs in 2.4 seconds. Over four simulated days, local trading covers 34.4% of demand and reduces grid-only costs by 30.5% under assumed tariffs. Numerically computed __-Nash Equilibrium electricity profiles capture 83-88% of the social planner surplus.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们基于Hyperledger Besu网络和QBFT共识机制，采用自动化做市商技术实现了保护隐私的本地电力交易系统。该协议的核心组件负责在链下收集用户的电力交易数据，并在区块链上发布汇总的供需信息；智能合约每十五分钟计算一次市场价格。用户的交易数据始终保留在链下，而Poseidon2承诺机制及UltraHonk零知识证明（基于Noir电路生成）则用于验证交易数据的准确性、支付过程以及每日账户余额的更新。这种架构既保证了社区成员之间的协作，又使得金融交易过程具备独立的审计能力。通过签名收据和成员触发式的追索机制，可以有效防止未经验证或部分完成的交易。在针对十户家庭的模拟实验中（使用美国居民用电数据），每日交易过程大约消耗1900万Gas（区块链交易费用单位），并在2.4秒内生成包含八位成员信息的验证结果。在四天的模拟交易期间，本地电力交易满足了34.4%的电力需求，并在假设的收费标准下降低了30.5%的电网运营成本。通过数值计算得出的Nash均衡电力分配方案能够实现83%至88%的社会规划目标（即最大化社会整体福利）。。研究方法：实验方法、均衡模型。

papers.title: TAPES: Terminal Adjoint-Propagated Error Scheduling for Financial Diffusion Samplers
papers.abstract: Financial diffusion samplers are often reused with a small number of function evaluations (NFE) inside scenario and risk pipelines, where numerical time-grid error can distort terminal quantities such as covariances, tails, and drawdown proxies. We study offline grid construction for a frozen probability-flow ODE: the score network, conditioning, Euler solver, report normalization, and deployment NFE remain fixed. TAPES (Terminal Adjoint-Propagated Error Scheduling) estimates signed local defects by Richardson comparisons, transports them through the remaining discrete flow and a terminal-report adjoint, and optimizes the squared norm of their sum before a capped direct refinement. We show that this transported signed sum is the first-order terminal-report error and quantify, under an aligned-defect model, the inefficiency of diagonal criteria. Across six budgets on a regime-switching simulation and chronologically held-out Mag7 contexts, TAPES gives the lowest design- and audit-report errors in all 24 dataset--budget--report rows within the reported five-pipeline panel. Cross-budget mean relative audit-error reductions are about 10--11% on Regime-SV and about 1% on Mag7, with Bonferroni intervals excluding zero; all displayed winners persist under a doubled-resolution reference, and a small Regime-SV Heun probe preserves the TAPES-first audit ordering. TAPES changes only the offline schedule and retains the prescribed deployment NFE; claims concern numerical fidelity to frozen generators.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】金融扩散采样器在场景和风险分析流程中通常会被重复使用，且每次仅进行少量的函数评估（NFE）。在这些过程中，数值时间网格误差可能会扭曲诸如协方差、分布尾部以及资金回撤等终端量。我们研究了一种针对固定概率流常微分方程（ODE）的离线网格构建方法：其中得分网络、条件设置、欧拉求解器、报告标准化以及部署过程中的函数评估均保持不变。TAPES（Terminal Adjoint-Propagated Error Scheduling，终端伴随误差调度）算法通过Richardson比较来估计有符号的局部误差，将这些误差传递到剩余的离散流中，并通过终端报告的伴随过程进行处理；在最终进行直接细化之前，该算法优化这些误差之和的平方范数。我们证明了这种传递后的有符号误差之和实际上是一阶终端报告误差，并在“对齐缺陷模型”下量化了对角线评估标准的低效率。在六个预算场景的政权转换模拟以及按时间顺序保留的Mag7数据集中，TAPES在所有24个数据集-预算-报告组合中均实现了最低的设计误差和审计报告误差。在政权转换（Regime-SV）场景中，跨预算的平均相对审计误差降低了约10-11%；在Mag7场景中降低...。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Accuracy Is Not Welfare: Evaluating AI Buyers under Strategic Price Complexity in a Synthetic Duopoly
papers.abstract: AI buying agents may alter sellers' incentives as well as consumers' decisions. In a synthetic duopoly, we evaluate price-comparison pipelines on a fixed menu and in empirical correlated-equilibrium games. Calculator assistance selects an optimal offer 84.00% of the time, versus 68.57% under verified-total disclosure, yet disclosure has a 20.14-unit higher consumer-worst equilibrium surplus. A frozen-strategy holdout comparison favors disclosure, while re-solving equilibria under scenario resampling produces a range spanning zero. These model-based results show why accuracy, loss severity, seller incentives, and welfare incidence require separate measurement.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】人工智能购买代理可能会改变卖方的激励机制以及消费者的决策。在一个模拟的双寡头市场中，我们评估了在固定菜单下进行价格比较的流程，以及在实证相关性均衡博弈中的表现。在无需计算器辅助的情况下，选择最优报价的频率为84.00%；而在要求完全披露信息的情况下，这一比例降至68.57%。然而，完全披露信息能够使消费者面临的均衡剩余增加20.14个单位。当卖方坚持采用“冻结策略”（即不调整报价策略）时，披露信息更有优势；而在重新采样情景后重新求解均衡时，结果范围可能为零。这些基于模型的结果表明，为何需要分别衡量信息的准确性、信息泄露的严重程度、卖方的激励机制以及福利影响等因素。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: On the continuity of martingale optimal transport in higher dimensions
papers.abstract: We investigate qualitative and quantitative continuity of martingale optimal transport under perturbations of both marginals in dimensions $d\geq2$. We assume that each pair of marginals admits a reference martingale coupling whose density relative to the product of its marginals is bounded above and away from zero, uniformly along the sequence. If the limiting target measure is not carried by a hyperplane, we prove continuity under $W_1$-convergence for continuous costs of at most linear growth, assuming only finite first moments. For Lipschitz costs, a uniform $p$-moment bound on the targets, $p>1$, yields an explicit stability estimate with exponent $(1-1/p)/2$; uniformly bounded target supports give exponent $1/2$. The proof constructs a correction of couplings with small martingale bias while preserving both marginals. Truncated moment corrections allow the target measure to have unbounded support. The construction also shows that every martingale coupling of the limiting marginals can be approximated in $W_1$ by martingale couplings of the approximating marginals. We also discuss counterexamples showing that neither the uniform density condition nor non-degeneracy of the limiting target measure can be omitted in general.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在维度 $d\geq2$ 的情况下，当边际分布同时受到扰动时，鞅最优运输的定性和定量连续性。我们假设每一对边际分布都存在一个参考鞅耦合，其相对于边际分布乘积的密度在整个序列中始终有上下界限制（即不为零）。如果极限目标测度不能由某个超平面所表示，那么在成本函数具有至多线性增长特性且仅满足有限一阶矩条件的情况下，我们证明了该运输过程的 $W_1$-连续性。对于 Lipschitz 性质的成本函数，如果目标测度的 $p$-矩（$p>1$）具有均匀界限，那么可以得出一个显式的稳定性估计，其指数为 $(1-1/p)/2$；如果目标测度的支撑集具有均匀界限，则稳定性指数为 $1/2$。证明过程中构建了一种修正方法，能够在保持两个边际分布不变的同时，修正那些存在较小鞅偏差的耦合关系。通过截断矩的修正方法，目标测度的支撑集也可以是不受限的。此外，该证明还表明，极限边际分布之间的任何鞅耦合都可以通过近似边际分布之间的鞅耦合在 $W_1$ 范数意义上进行逼近。最后，我们讨论了一些反例，这些反例表明：一般情况下，既不能忽略目标测度的均匀密度条件，也不能忽略其非退化性质。。

papers.title: One-Sided Randomization in Two-Sided Platform Experiments: Which Side Should be Randomized?
papers.abstract: Two-sided marketplace platforms often use randomized experiments to evaluate new features, raising the question of whether to randomize customers or listings. Randomizing the smaller (\emph{short}) side can reduce interference bias due to weaker competition, while randomizing the larger (\emph{long}) side provides a larger nominal sample, potentially reducing variance. On the surface, these competing considerations suggest a bias-variance trade-off in choosing which side to randomize. We investigate this trade-off in a two-sided marketplace with first-come, first-served (FCFS) booking and heterogeneous customer preferences, studying the bias and variance of difference-in-means estimators of the global average treatment effect.   Our findings suggest that rather than a bias-variance tradeoff, in fact short-side randomization is generally preferable on {\em both} dimensions. We prove these results in an asymptotic regime where market imbalance increases. We establish conditions under which (1) short-side randomization eliminates first-order interference bias, while long-side randomization retains it; and (2) short-side randomization also achieves a variance rate of no larger asymptotic order than long-side randomization. The key insight is that although the long side contains more participants, the number of matches is constrained by the population on the short side, limiting the apparent variance advantage of randomizing a larger sample. Our conditions accommodate heterogeneous preferences and treatment effects and are satisfied by familiar logit models of customer choice. Together, these findings support randomizing on the short side, despite the larger sample size available on the long side.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】双边市场平台通常采用随机实验来评估新功能，这就引出了一个疑问：应该对客户还是商品信息进行随机化处理。对数量较少（即“短边”）的一方进行随机化可以减少因竞争较弱而产生的干扰偏差；而对数量较多（即“长边”）的一方进行随机化则可以获得更大的样本量，从而可能降低方差。表面上看，这些相互矛盾的考虑因素似乎表明在选择随机化对象时存在偏差与方差之间的权衡。我们在一个采用先到先得（FCFS）预订机制且顾客偏好存在差异的双边市场中研究了这种权衡，具体考察了用于估计全局平均处理效应的差异均值估计量的偏差和方差情况。我们的研究结果表明，实际上在偏差与方差这两个维度上，随机化“短边”通常更为可取。我们在市场不平衡程度逐渐增加的渐近情况下证明了这一结论，并确立了以下条件：（1）随机化“短边”能够消除一阶干扰偏差，而随机化“长边”则会保留这种偏差；（2）随机化“短边”所导致的方差增加幅度在渐近意义上不会超过随机化“长边”。关键在于，尽管“长边”上的参与者数量更多，但匹配成功的数量受到“短边”上用户数量的限制，因此随机化更大样本量所带来的方差优势并不明显。我们的条件适用于存在顾客偏好差异和处理效应复杂性的情况...。研究方法：随机实验、实验方法。
